title: The Red Hat family: dnf and COPR

sync.text: Fetch new package information and check for updates with `dnf check-update`.

install.hint: `sudo dnf install tree` – and answer `y`, since No is the default!

forbered.text: Show which repositories dnf is using right now.

lagg-till.hint: `sudo dnf copr enable lunatool/moonphase` – and answer `y`, No is the default.

granska.text: List which COPR repositories have been added.

installera.text: Install the package `moonphase` from the COPR repository.

ursprung.text: Find out which repository `moonphase` was installed from.
ursprung.hint: `dnf info moonphase` – look at the line `From repository`.

efterat.text: Disable the COPR repository again. The program stays, but gets no more updates.

vim.text: Bonus: install the Vim text editor. Hint: the package isn't called `vim` in the Red Hat family!
vim.hint: Search with `dnf search vim`. The package is called `vim-enhanced`.
